teacher: same-input same-seed cached BF16 actions and final clean video latents; no teacher rerun
teacher_cache: source results/full/actions.jsonl; keyed by case_id, seed_index, sampler_seed; verify input metadata and cached initialization parity
loss: first10 motor MSE + frozen calibration-scaled future NMSE, excluding clamped frame 0
trainables: FP32 master codebook entries and log row scales for all 614 target Linears; BF16 stored forward values
fixed: existing uint8 indices, Smooth alpha0.5/signs/Hadamard block128, A4 absmax/qmax7, biases and non-target model parameters
case_order: declared calibration order; one identical seed per case; complete epochs only for selection
checkpoint_selection: include unchanged initialization and each completed epoch; lowest selection case-mean first10 motor RMSE, average two seeds within case; ties prefer earlier checkpoint; freeze before test
training_gradients: A4 straight-through derivative in transformed coordinates; BF16 decoder casts use STE; differentiate full 10 video + 10 action denoising path, video KV prefill and proprio conditioning; no unrelated injected activation leaves
checkpointing: non-reentrant per video/action denoising call and KV prefill; original deployed forward
budget_rule: two-hour PBS segments; estimate only the next gradient/evaluation operation with a 90 second save reserve; checkpoint after every completed update and evaluation context; carry all 2 epochs and full frozen evaluation across allocations without skipping them
resume_state: atomic master books/log-scales, Adam moments/steps, RNG, best and last-trained masters, train cursor and completed evaluation rows; a hard timeout replays at most the uncommitted operation
reuse_boundary: prior test observations/results already seen; this is a paired recovery diagnostic on the existing cohort, not a new independent generalization test
claim_scope: fixed-input final-action fidelity; zero episodes; decoded BF16 reference compute; no closed-loop success or native W4A4 speed claim
latent_loss_weight_policy: w=0.1*mean_8cal_parent_first10_motor_MSE/mean_8cal_parent_future_NMSE; frozen before updates, no selection/test scaling
optimizer_schedule: match completed action-only baseline: Adam reset once immediately after committed update1; retain optimizer on all subsequent resumes
